description: This file contains functions related to parsing and handling object IDs (OIDs) in a version control context, including setting up hashing algorithms and parsing hexadecimal representations of OIDs.

methods.name: int cl_setup_hash_algo(void)
methods.description: Initializes and returns the hash algorithm to be used, based on environment variable or default.

methods.name: void cl_parse_oid(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Parses a hexadecimal string into an object ID (`struct object_id`) using the specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: void cl_parse_any_oid(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Determines the hash algorithm and parses a hex string into an object ID.

ctags.name: cl_parse_oid
ctags.signature: (const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
